summary: Prepare partial-clone objects in the local test caller before evidence signing, including historical blobs; the signer never fetches from a promisor remote and refuses incomplete source repositories.

rules.detail: Evidence signatures and verifier requirements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Complete repositories behave as before. st-test hydrates partial clones using the caller's normal Git context before signing; other callers must prepare their source objects too.

manual.detail: No manual action for st-test users.

recovery.detail: Caller hydration only adds Git objects; no refs are changed. No rollback concerns.
